title: Phishing Forensics: dissect the email
description: Lying headers, spoofed HELO, SPF +all and malware attachments: dissect phishing emails like a SOC analyst.

phishing-forensics-t01-q01.prompt: From 02-urgente.eml: the HELO claims mail.banco-seguro.com but lies. What is the REAL origin domain (check Return-Path and Message-ID)? Submit it to /verify?origin= for the flag.

phishing-forensics-t01-q02.prompt: Same email: Authentication-Results shows three failed checks. Write all three in alphabetical order (spf,dkim,dmarc) with their value, format 'spf=X,dkim=Y,dmarc=Z'.

phishing-forensics-t01-q03.prompt: The attacker domain's SPF record (check-spf) contains a policy that makes it useless. Query /check-spf?domain=<attacker-domain> for the flag.

2.title: The disguised URL and the attachment

phishing-forensics-t02-q01.prompt: The email 02 link says 'banco-seguro.com' but points elsewhere. What is the real domain (with port)? Submit it to /verify?url= for the flag.

phishing-forensics-t02-q02.prompt: What is the attachment's exact filename (Content-Disposition)? Submit it to /verify?attachment= for the flag.

phishing-forensics-t02-q03.prompt: Besides URL and attachment, the email uses 3 social-pressure techniques. Which one imposes a deadline to act?
